audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls this 'Favoured — difficulty 4/10' while the data is 46.15% over 195 games and every whys[] entry from Levels 4-5 onward hands the lane to Trundle.
audit.why: diff/diffRating are left untouched rather than guessed, but the level chart understating Trundle was fixable from the packet and the page's own text.
audit.corrected: Chart moved to the packet: Trundle on Level 1, Levels 4-5, First item and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven chart rows disagreed with the prose sitting beside them: everything was flattened to 'Skill' except two Fiora rows in the wrong places.
audit.why: whys[0] 'he holds a slight edge' (Trundle), whys[1] 'you win the short trade outright' (Fiora), whys[2] 'Even' (Skill), whys[3] 'he wins the level 4-5 window' (Trundle), whys[4] 'your one window to flip the all-in' (Fiora), whys[5] 'he out-trades you' (Trundle), whys[6] 'the late 1v1 is his' (Trundle). The packet chart already reads exactly that.
audit.corrected: Trundle / Fiora / Skill / Trundle / Fiora / Trundle / Trundle, with phases[3], [4] and [6] whys rewritten to match their new sides.

audit.why: The mirror's central correction — that Riposte does NOT stun Trundle, because his kit contains a slow, two zones and a targeted steal but no immobilize — is already stated correctly in this page's early block. What was missing were the numbers: Chomp is a 3.5s auto-reset bite, Pillar of Ice is 21/19.5/18/16.5/15s of real impassable terrain that cuts a Lunge path, Frozen Domain is 18s and raises healing from ALL sources, and Subjugate is 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Attach the cooldowns: Subjugate 80s at rank 3, Pillar of Ice 21s at rank 1, and name Frozen Domain as the healing amplifier that Grievous Wounds has to pre-empt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is named in the itemization block but the reason never reaches the trade advice.
audit.why: Frozen Domain gives 'increased healing from all sources while on it' and King's Tribute heals him off every nearby unit death, so an extended trade on his zone is a losing proposition unless Grievous Wounds is already applied.
audit.corrected: Frozen Domain raises all his healing — Grievous Wounds before you step on it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Subjugate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trundle's window: Chomp on 3.5s and Frozen Domain out-sustain your poke, and Pillar of Ice walls your Lunge re-engage.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Trundle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grand Challenge marks four Vitals and its heal field out-races his drain — force the all-in the moment Subjugate is down, never while it is up.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Trundle carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, Subjugate steals your armour and MR and heals him through Vitals. Never solo-duel him once his R is up.

edits.before: Steals your stats. Out-duel him before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Subjugate steals armour and MR, 80s at rank 3. Only fight while it is down.

edits.before: That is Trundle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Frozen Domain raises all his healing — Grievous Wounds before you step on it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is real terrain on 21s — it cuts your Lunge path.
